**CopilotKit is the open-source stack for putting AI agents in front of real users.** Bring the agent you already built, on any framework, and give it chat, generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop in React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Microsoft Teams. When it goes to production, add **CopilotKit Intelligence** and your agents keep getting better: conversations that pick up where users left off, memory across sessions, and **Continual Learning** that turns real use into Skills you review and publish. releases.name: channels/v0.12.0
releases.body:
### Security

- Includes security fixes for Teams and other Channels integrations.

We recommend upgrading the supported `@copilotkit/channels*` packages used by
your application to `0.12.0`, including `@copilotkit/channels` and
`@copilotkit/channels-teams` where installed. If you use Telegram, review the
migration guidance below before upgrading.

### Features

- Render static JSX as images in managed Slack and Teams messages. (#6146)
- Combine rendered cards with native buttons and carousel layouts. (#6146)

### Fixes

- Keep Takumi out of native-only app bundles to avoid Next.js build failures. (#7874)

Image rendering is opt-in: import `takumiRenderer` from
`@copilotkit/channels/takumi` and configure
`render: { renderer: takumiRenderer }` when creating your channel.

### Breaking Changes

- Remove the built-in Telegram adapter and umbrella export. (#7928)

`@copilotkit/channels-telegram` and `@copilotkit/channels/telegram` are no longer
included. Applications using either must migrate to a custom adapter or another
supported channel before upgrading.

readmeHtml:
Docs · Examples · Intelligence · OpenBot · Discord





CopilotKit is the open-source stack for putting AI agents in front of real users. Bring the agent you already built, on any framework, and give it chat, generative UI, shared state, and human-in-the-loop in React, Angular, Vue, React Native, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.

When it goes to production, add CopilotKit Intelligence and your agents keep getting better: conversations that pick up where users left off, memory across sessions, and Continual Learning that turns real use into Skills you review and publish.

We're also the team behind AG-UI, the open Agent–User Interaction protocol adopted by Google, Microsoft, AWS, LangChain, Mastra, PydanticAI, and more.

What's new

What's new What it is
🪁 CopilotKit Soar AI coworkers your company owns, running on your own servers. Powered by OpenBot. Now in early access →
🔁 Continual Learning Agents learn from full-stack trajectories (what the agent did and what your users did), captured over AG-UI.
🤖 OpenBot Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own. MIT licensed.
🧩 AG-UI 1.0 + A2UI 1.0 CopilotKit now speaks AG-UI 1.0 and the A2UI 1.0 spec for declarative generative UI.
💬 Channels Write Channels JSX once. Render native Block Kit in Slack and Adaptive Cards in Microsoft Teams.

Full changelog in What's New.

Quick start

Let your coding agent do it. Paste this prompt into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or any coding agent running in your project. It inspects your app and walks you through the integration.

Help me get started with CopilotKit. From the root of my project, run this
command and follow the instructions:

npx --yes copilotkit@latest onboard start

Start a new project. Scaffolds a fresh app in its own directory. It won't touch an app you already have.

npx copilotkit@latest create

Give your coding agent CopilotKit skills. Helps it build features and debug issues once you're set up (learn more).

npx copilotkit@latest skills install
Prefer to wire it up by hand? Here's a Next.js app in three files. 
npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/runtime
# .env.local
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key
// app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]]/route.ts
import {
  CopilotRuntime,
  createCopilotRuntimeHandler,
  BuiltInAgent,
} from "@copilotkit/runtime/v2";

const runtime = new CopilotRuntime({
  agents: { default: new BuiltInAgent({ model: "openai:gpt-6-luna" }) },
});

const handler = createCopilotRuntimeHandler({
  runtime,
  basePath: "/api/copilotkit",
});
export { handler as GET, handler as POST, handler as PATCH, handler as DELETE };
// app/page.tsx
"use client";
import { CopilotKitProvider, CopilotSidebar } from "@copilotkit/react-core/v2";
import "@copilotkit/react-core/v2/styles.css";

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <CopilotKitProvider runtimeUrl="/api/copilotkit">
      <main>
        <h1>Your App</h1>
        <CopilotSidebar />
      </main>
    </CopilotKitProvider>
  );
}

Already running LangGraph, CrewAI, Mastra, or another framework? Swap the Built-in Agent for yours using that framework's quickstart.

getting-started-with-one-command.mp4

How it works

Your agent handles reasoning and execution. CopilotKit turns its work into a product experience. Events stream over AG-UI, so the agent can show its work as it happens, read what the user is looking at, call tools that render UI, and pause for a person to approve the next step. Your agent logic stays the same on every surface.

What you can build

Whole.Generative.UI.v5.mp4
Feature What it does
Chat components Start with a working chat, replace the parts you need with slots, or go fully Headless UI.
Generative UI Agents render real UI, from your own components to A2UI specs to sandboxed MCP Apps.
Shared state One state layer that both the agent and your UI read and write in real time.
Human-in-the-loop Agents pause for input, confirmation, or edits before they act.
Frontend tools Let the agent take actions inside your app, with your code doing the work.
AG-UI Streams Conversations that survive reloads, devices, and sessions, with generative UI intact.
Voice and WebMCP Talk to your agent, and expose your app's actions to browser agents.
Inspector A localhost overlay that shows threads, agents, and learning as you build.

Full control with useAgent

Every component is built on hooks you can use directly. useAgent sits right on top of AG-UI and gives you programmatic control of the agent connection.

import { useAgent } from "@copilotkit/react-core/v2";

function CityPicker() {
  const { agent } = useAgent({ agentId: "my_agent" });

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{agent.state.city}</h1>
      <button onClick={() => agent.setState({ city: "NYC" })}>Set city</button>
    </div>
  );
}

More in the programmatic control docs.

Generative UI, three ways

demo-generative-ui.mp4
Type The agent… Built on
Controlled picks from components you registered AG-UI tool calls and state
Declarative describes UI as a structured spec your app renders A2UI
Open-ended ships a full interface that runs in a sandbox MCP Apps

Want to go deeper? The Generative UI educational repo walks through all three.

Works with your stack

One agent backend. Every frontend.

Surface Status Get started
⚛️ React / Next.js ✅ GA Quickstart
🅰️ Angular ✅ Supported Quickstart
💚 Vue ✅ Supported Quickstart
📱 React Native ✅ Supported Quickstart
💬 Slack / Microsoft Teams ✅ GA on cloud-hosted Intelligence Slack · Teams
💬 Discord / WhatsApp ✅ Channels SDK adapters Channels
🔜 Google Chat / iMessage / SMS 🟡 On the roadmap Channels
🪁 CopilotKit Soar, powered by OpenBot ✨ Early access Get early access

Agent frameworks. LangGraph · Deep Agents · CrewAI · Mastra · Google ADK · PydanticAI · Microsoft Agent Framework · AWS Strands · Claude Agent SDK · LlamaIndex · Agno · AG2 · A2A · or CopilotKit's Built-in Agent.

CopilotKit Intelligence

Most agents plateau at launch quality. CopilotKit Intelligence is the production layer that keeps yours improving. It works with the CopilotKit app and agent framework you already run, cloud-hosted or self-hosted on your own infrastructure.

  • Continual Learning: real use of your app becomes evidence-backed insights, then Skills you review and publish. Every learned behavior traces back to its source.
  • AG-UI Streams: conversations pick up where users left off, with messages, generative UI, and live runs restored as they were.
  • User Memories: durable facts and preferences carried across conversations, recalled semantically.
  • Product Analytics: see what users ask for, what agents do, and where people get value.
  • Channels: Slack and Microsoft Teams infrastructure for the agent you already built.
  • Self-hosted: the same platform inside your Kubernetes cluster, VPC, or air-gapped environment.

The Developer plan is free. 👉 Connect Intelligence in 5 minutes → · Compare open source and Intelligence

AI coworkers, built on CopilotKit

We build real products on this stack, and open-source them.

OpenBot is an open-source agent workspace for your employees. Every AI coworker gets a computer of its own, with a browser, files, and tools, and every action is decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent and any model.

CopilotKit Soar turns that core into one business-ready product. It gives each employee an AI coworker that works in your company's tools, learns new tasks from the people it works with, and runs on your own servers. Our engineers set it up with you, then hand you the keys.

Soar is in early access today. 👉 Get early access →

OpenBot
AI coworkers, each with a computer of its own.

 OpenDots
Always-on coworkers for text, calls, and Slack.

 OpenMuse
A personal agent for iOS, Android, and web.

 OpenTag
An on-call triage bot for Slack and Teams.

AG-UI: the Agent–User Interaction protocol

AG-UI is the open, event-based protocol that connects agents to the people using them. MCP connects agents to tools, A2A connects agents to each other, and AG-UI connects them to your users. CopilotKit is built on it, and it has first-party integrations across LangChain, CrewAI, Mastra, PydanticAI, Google ADK, AWS, Microsoft, and more.

npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app

👉 Explore AG-UI on GitHub →

Community

Discord · Docs · X · LinkedIn · Blog

Contributing

Thanks for your interest in contributing to CopilotKit! 💜 We value every contribution, whether it's code, docs, a demo app, or spreading the word.

  • Code: start with CONTRIBUTING.md.
  • Docs: see the docs contribution guide.
  • Not sure where to start? Join our Discord and we'll help you find something.

License

The source code in this repository is available under the MIT License.

aiSummary.oneLiner: Framework for integrating AI agents and Generative UI components into web and mobile apps.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: CopilotKit provides a comprehensive suite of tools to seamlessly integrate intelligent AI agents and chat interfaces into modern web and mobile applications. It automatically handles the complex, real-time synchronization of application state between the frontend client and the LLM backend. The framework pioneers 'Generative UI', where agents can dynamically render interactive interface components in real-time based on deduced user intent. It acts as the primary UI layer for the AG-UI protocol, allowing developers to write complex agent logic once and deploy it uniformly across React, Angular, React Native, and Slack environments.
keyFeatures: Generative UI rendering: Enables AI agents to dynamically generate and display interactive interface components during conversations.
State synchronization engine: Automatically keeps frontend application data in sync with the backend language model context.
Cross-platform deployment: Supports integration across React, Angular, React Native, and standard messaging platforms like Slack.
AG-UI protocol support: Serves as the standardized presentation layer for executing agent-driven user interfaces.
Drop-in chat components: Provides pre-built, highly customizable chat interfaces to accelerate integration timelines.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: CopilotKit is designed for frontend developers and full-stack engineers looking to embed sophisticated AI features into user interfaces. It requires proficiency in modern UI frameworks like React or Angular.
